market_story: Unchanged from the run168b recipe this run replays - no mechanism was added, removed or re-tuned. ERCOT's price formation here is: coal two-shifts through price formation on its own measured per-plant year curves (backing to the mustrun floor on ordinary overnight LMPs, exactly as SCED did); merchant gas CC self-commits and is held at its measured LSL/HSL p50 by the commitment bridge rather than by a floor tuned to the residual; the offline fast-start CT pool is offered at its own measured start-inclusive SCED2 ladder; and the multiproduct AS co-optimisation holds ERCOT's measured hourly plan, with the date-gated ECRS conservative-deployment family forming the scarcity hours it can reach. What this run newly establishes about the market is a NEGATIVE with a market story: the slow-start half of the offline increment carries no MW. ERCOT's CC fleet does not wait offline-and-cheap for tight hours - it self-commits into real time and is already loaded (96.4% committed / 98.0% loaded at the 2023 gap hours), so its RT offline-startable share measures 0.02-0.07% of live capability and what little exists offers near cost, not at scarcity. The missed 2023 tail is therefore not a mispriced CC start; it remains the ledgered C3c model-class limitation - equilibrium conduct on the energy stack that a competitive-offer LP does not form.
